# Pin content-sized rows sized by a locked column, on both sides

## Context

On 2026-10-16 the operator asked whether content-sized rows (#19658, 13.3's headline) were tested with locked columns. The answer was: only implicitly.

- **Showcase e2e:** `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs` checks that row heights are "alike in all three bodies". Only its start-locked Title wraps; its end-locked State column does not.
- **WrapTextMeasure e2e:** `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs` uses the `grid-wrap-text` fixture, whose wrapped `tag` column is locked to the start. A probe of that fixture's first screen (1200×800, 16 rendered rows) found that the locked `tag` holds no row's tallest text: the center `text` holds 12 and 4 sit at the `rowHeight` floor. The spec's fit check therefore passes without a single row being sized by a locked body.
- **No wrapped column locked to the end:** no fixture or example has one.

A local probe ran the same fixture with `tag` locked to the end and narrowed to 56px, served through a route rewrite with no repo change. Five of 16 rendered rows took their height from the end-locked cell alone, and every row fit its tallest text in both bodies. The engine works; nothing in CI would notice if it stopped.

## The Problem

The contract "every row is as tall as its tallest wrapped text, in each body alike" has two halves:
- the bodies agree on a height;
- the height covers every body's text.

CI pins the first half. The second half is pinned only for the center body, because no CI fixture's first screen has a row whose tallest text is locked, at either side. A regression that measured only the center body, for example a measure pass that skipped `bodyEnd`, would stay green.

## The Architectural Reality

- `grid.View#measureRowHeights` (`src/grid/View.mjs`) collects the wrapped cells of every body through `me.bodies` (`bodyStart`, `body`, `bodyEnd`). It feeds them per record into `measuredHeight(fields)`, which takes the maximum across fields.
- Premeasurement (#19688), `grid.View#runAheadMeasure`, measures rows before they mount through a hidden measure row per body (`rowMeasureVdom`). It is a second path that has to cover the locked bodies too.
- `grid-wrap-text` is shared: `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` asserts timing- and geometry-sensitive behaviour on its current columns, and `grid-two-views` imports its store. Adding an end column there would change what those specs measure.

## The Fix

1. **A new component fixture, `test/playwright/component/apps/grid-locked-wrap/`.** It holds one grid constructed with three wrapped columns: one locked to the start, one in the center, and one locked to the end. Its records rotate which of the three holds the long text, so every screen has rows sized by each body.
2. **A spec beside `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs`.** In a real browser it asserts:
   - each of the three bodies holds the tallest text of at least one rendered row (the non-vacuity check);
   - every rendered row is as tall as its tallest text in all three bodies, on the first screen and after a scroll.
3. **Red first, by mutation.** Dropping `bodyEnd` from the measure pass, and separately `bodyStart`, turns the spec red. If premeasurement still covers a dropped body, its path is mutated as well, so the spec provably reaches each locked body's measurement.

No engine change is expected. If the spec finds a defect, the fix goes in the same PR only if it is local to the measure pass; anything wider becomes its own ticket.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] AC-1: `grid-locked-wrap` constructs a grid with wrapped columns locked to the start and to the end, plus a wrapped center column. On its first screen, each body holds at least one row's tallest text.
- [x] AC-2: in a real browser, the spec asserts each body's non-vacuity and every rendered row's fit, in all three bodies, before and after a scroll.
- [x] AC-3: the spec is red with `bodyEnd`, and separately `bodyStart`, removed from content-sized measurement, and green on `dev`. The PR body records both mutation runs.
- [x] AC-4: `WrapTextMeasure.spec.mjs` and `PremeasureRowsNL.spec.mjs` stay green and unchanged.

## Out of Scope

- Locked columns combined with row animation, anchor correction, two views on one store, or a responsive breakpoint. These are the other locked-column gaps reported on 2026-10-16, each a separate leaf if wanted.
- A non-vacuity assertion in `IssuesShowcase.spec.mjs`: that spec pins the showcase, not the measurement contract.
- Any change to `grid-wrap-text` or its specs.
